newsitem.title: USA: Rubin unsure IMF gold sale pact reachable today.
newsitem.headline: Rubin unsure IMF gold sale pact reachable today.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Friday the United States is working toward getting an agreement on gold sales by the International Monetary Fund.
But he told reporters before a speech to a Congressional Black Caucus conference that he did not know if an agreement would be reached at an IMF board meeting today.
Asked if there would be an agreement today, Rubin said, "we're working to it. I truly don't know. It's a complicated and complex issue."
